Risk: GPU out-of-memory / system freeze on 8 GB VRAM, 16 GB RAM
Mitigation: 4-bit NF4 quantisation; pre-flight VRAM/RAM checks; heavy jobs run only when RAM is free

Risk: Library upgrade breaks code (transformers 5.x removed StableDropout, warmup_ratio)
Mitigation: Compatibility shim; pinned versions; WASSA re-validated at 100% match on 1,800 pre-upgrade scores

Risk: Silent failure - default 'sdpa' attention returned no attention weights
Mitigation: Forced 'eager' attention + hard-fail assertion so the feature cannot silently switch off

Risk: Train/inference mismatch in d1 (trained on situation text, fed user messages)
Mitigation: Retrained on first user message; honest accuracy reported

Risk: Unstable training of larger model (roberta-large diverged to 5.0%)
Mitigation: Warmup 0.06 + lr 1e-5; failed run not reported as a result
Fixed seed 42 for sampling and data; earlier noisy numbers discarded

Risk: Free API models retired or withdrawn mid-project (Llama 3.3 on Groq, DeepSeek on GitHub Models, Gemini quota, Mistral Large 403 on both team accounts)
Mitigation: Judge panel from several providers; final comparison on the two judges that scored every system; two- vs three-judge panel checked (rho 0.98, same ranking)
Stratified short/long split across two teammates' accounts with dedup merge

Risk: Late design changes invalidate in-progress judging
Mitigation: Freeze the final system outputs while teammates judge; repetition penalty moved to future work

Risk: Automatic metrics reward length or keywords, not empathy
Mitigation: Multiple independent signals: rules, WASSA, AI-judge panel, human study; length-matched analysis

Risk: Unsafe reply to crisis disclosure (no self-harm category in ED labels)
Mitigation: Disclaimer and helplines in demo UI; stated as limitation; crisis gate listed as future work

Risk: Only one member can run GPU work
Mitigation: No-GPU tasks (judging, writing, human eval) assigned to teammates with written command guides
